from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

retry = Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=1, status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504])
session = requests.Session()
session.mount("https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))
session.mount("http://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))

resp.raise_for_status()

Not run here. `total=3` = 3 retries after first attempt (4 requests max); sleeps ~1s, 2s, 4s (urllib3 2.x; 1.x skips first sleep). Retries connection errors, read timeouts and listed statuses, honours `Retry-After`. Exhausted → `requests.exceptions.RetryError` or `ConnectionError`.

Gotcha: POST/PATCH not retried by default (non-idempotent). Only if endpoint is safe to repeat: `allowed_methods=None`.
